title: Made an arena shooter where the wake is the real weapon, not the gun
author: synap5e
selftext:
Been building Gridwake, an arena shooter with a Geometry Wars vibe. The turret auto-aims and fires on its own, so it's really more of a backup, most of the actual strategy is in how you move. Your ship leaves a trail behind it, and if you loop back through your own trail it closes a circuit that wipes out anything caught inside. Most of the fun ends up being luring enemies into a spot and cutting them off with your own path.

Codex handled the gameplay systems, enemy behavior, refits, UI, and testing. Opus 5 modeled the ship.
